bookings_contact_after_draft.name: bookings_contact_after_draft
bookings_contact_after_draft.value: "bookings"."status" = 'DRAFT' OR ("bookings"."contact_name" IS NOT NULL AND "bookings"."contact_email" IS NOT NULL AND "bookings"."contact_phone" IS NOT NULL)

bookings_contact_complete.name: bookings_contact_complete
bookings_contact_complete.value:
("bookings"."contact_name" IS NULL AND "bookings"."contact_email" IS NULL AND "bookings"."contact_phone" IS NULL)
        OR ("bookings"."contact_name" IS NOT NULL AND "bookings"."contact_email" IS NOT NULL AND "bookings"."contact_phone" IS NOT NULL)

payments_checkout_reference.name: payments_checkout_reference
payments_checkout_reference.value: "payments"."booking_id" IS NOT NULL OR "payments"."draft_id" IS NOT NULL
